title: Homer Simpson from a list of 3D coordinates
question:
OpenSCAD source containing one polyhedron(): a triangulated surface given as a list of 3D points (mm) and triangles (point indices). The object is in its natural upright orientation: +z is up.



What does this triangulated surface depict?
credit: Mesh 'homer' from alecjacobson/common-3d-test-models (Stanford 3D Scanning Repository, Keenan Crane, Blender, Newell and others; research test models); decimated with fast-simplification, centred, scaled to ±50 mm, converted to z-up (no rotation otherwise).

title: An elephant hidden in 420 scatter points
question: The 420 data points of this scatter plot, taken together, form the silhouette of a recognisable figure. What is it?
credit: Points sampled uniformly from the filled silhouette of U+1F418 (OpenMoji 17.0.0 (CC BY-SA 4.0, hfg-gmuend/openmoji)), jittered, shuffled.

title: A cat from RGB numbers
question:
Plain-text PPM (P3): 48x34 pixels, one image row per line, each pixel as R G B (0-255).



this is a small photograph. What is its main subject?
credit: Photo: File:BEN Bengalian kitten (4492540155).jpg by Nickolas Titkov from Moscow, Russian Federation (CC BY-SA 2.0), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:BEN_Bengalian_kitten_(4492540155).jpg. Downsampled to 48 px wide.

title: A motorcycle from coloured polygons
question:
An SVG drawing of a photograph: 157 flat-coloured polygons, painted in order (largest areas first, later shapes on top).



Without rendering it: what is the main subject of the photograph this drawing depicts?
credit: Photo: File:BMW S1000 RR Studio.JPG by Stefan Krause, Germany (CC BY-SA 3.0), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:BMW_S1000_RR_Studio.JPG. Segmented with SLIC + colour-merging (scikit-image) into 157 regions, each a simplified polygon.

title: A castle from CSS clip paths
question:
An HTML/CSS drawing of a photograph: 161 absolutely positioned divs, each a flat colour clipped to a polygon (clip-path percentages are relative to the div's own box). Later divs paint on top.



Without rendering it: what is the main subject of the photograph this drawing depicts?
credit: Photo: File:001 Chateau de Chillon and Dents du Midi Photo by Giles Laurent.jpg by Giles Laurent (CC BY-SA 4.0), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:001_Chateau_de_Chillon_and_Dents_du_Midi_Photo_by_Giles_Laurent.jpg. Same segmentation method, emitted as 161 clip-path divs.

title: An astronaut from SVG paths
question: The SVG is an illustration of a single person at work. Is the person depicted as a man or a woman, and what is their profession (choose from the options)? Answer as gender,profession.
credit: Label from the Unicode name of emoji U+1F469 U+200D U+1F680 (Twemoji v17.0.3 (CC-BY 4.0, jdecked/twemoji)); paths re-encoded (new scale/offset, absolute coordinates, ids removed).
